description: Counts of $autocapture, $rageclick, and $dead_click events grouped by the element chain they occurred on, ordered by count Counts of $autocapture, $rageclick, and $dead_click events grouped by the element chain they occurred on, ordered by count. GET /api/projects/{project_id}/elements/stats/
context:
GET /api/projects/{project_id}/elements/stats/
Counts of $autocapture, $rageclick, and $dead_click events grouped by the element chain they occurred on, ordered by count. Defaults to all three event types; narrow with the include parameter.
Required: project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.
Optional: data_attributes (query) — Comma-separated data attribute names (wildcards allowed, e.g. data-*). When provided, each element's attributes map is filtered to matching attr__* keys, shrinking the response.; date_from (query) — Start of the date range (e.g. -7d, 2024-01-01). Defaults to last 7 days.; date_to (query) — End of the date range (e.g. 2024-01-31). Defaults to now.; filter_test_accounts (query) — When true, applies the project's internal-and-test-account filters to the underlying events. Pass the lowercase string true; other truthy spellings are ignored.; include (query) — Event types to include: $autocapture, $rageclick, $dead_click. Defaults to all three. Accepts repeated parameters, a JSON array, or a comma-separated list.; limit (query) — Maximum rows per page; offset (query) — Pagination offset; properties (query) — JSON-encoded list of property filters to apply to the underlying events, e.g. [{"key": "$current_url", "value": "https://example.com/page"}] or [{"key": "email", "value": "@posthog.com", "operator": "icontains", "type": "person"}]. Supports event, person, cohort, element, and HogQL property filter types.; sampling_factor (query) — Sampling factor between 0 and 1
